policyEnrollment: Explicit authorized deployment policy; never created by runtime

issuer.purpose: Verify original independent evidence and record scoped certificate

signer.purpose: Sign only approved exact digest under separate pinned key

appDatabaseRole: Existing application schema owner privileges retained; deployment administrator is trusted
schedule: Reuse existing event wake and bounded backup schedule; never duplicate schedules; completed payments excluded by original selectors
isolation: Separate process/database/Redis/wallet/credentials/policy/Drive per app; no shared tenant switching
